q_en:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

The mountain range looked ______________ from a distance.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

The mountain range looked ______________ from a distance.
solution: सही उत्तर 'magnificent' (शानदार) है, जो एक adjective (विशेषण) है और 'looked' के बाद पर्वत श्रृंखला (mountain range) की विशेषता बताने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है। अन्य विकल्प: magnify (verb), magnificence (noun), magnificently (adverb)। अतः विकल्प 2 सही है।

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) thereby altering ecosystems, and light pollution
(P) and noise are affecting the amount and
(Q) increasing pressure on natural habitats,
(R) the quality of sleep in wild animals
(S) climate change and human activities are applying
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) thereby altering ecosystems, and light pollution
(P) and noise are affecting the amount and
(Q) increasing pressure on natural habitats,
(R) the quality of sleep in wild animals
(S) climate change and human activities are applying
solution: सही क्रम SQOPR है। वाक्य 'climate change and human activities are applying' (S) से शुरू होगा। इसके बाद 'increasing pressure on natural habitats,' (Q), फिर 'thereby altering ecosystems, and light pollution' (O), उसके बाद 'and noise are affecting the amount and' (P) और अंत में 'the quality of sleep in wild animals' (R) आएगा। अतः विकल्प 2 सही है।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

She read about ____ invention that changed_____ course of medical history in ____ newspaper.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

She read about ____ invention that changed_____ course of medical history in ____ newspaper.
solution: यहाँ 'invention' के लिए स्वर ध्वनि (vowel sound) के कारण 'an' का प्रयोग होगा। 'course of medical history' एक निश्चित बात है, अतः यहाँ निश्चित उपपद 'the' आएगा। 'newspaper' एक सामान्य एकवचन संज्ञा है, इसलिए इसके पहले 'a' लगेगा। अतः 'an, the, a' सही विकल्प है।

q_en:

They walked __________ the park on their way home.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

They walked __________ the park on their way home.
solution: पार्क या जंगल जैसी किसी घिरी हुई जगह के एक सिरे से दूसरे सिरे तक जाने के संदर्भ में 'through' (में से होकर) का प्रयोग सबसे उपयुक्त माना जाता है। अतः 'They walked through the park' सही होगा।

q_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.

Machine learning is a subfield of artificial intelligence, which is broadly defined as the capability of a machine to imitate intelligent human behaviour. Artificial intelligence systems are used to perform complex tasks in a way that is similar to how humans solve problems.
The goal of AI is to create computer models that exhibit 'intelligent behaviours' like humans, according to Boris Katz, a principal research scientist and head of the InfoLab Group at CSAIL. This means machines that can recognize a visual scene, understand a text written in natural language, or perform an action in the physical world.
Machine learning is one way to use AI. It was defined in the 1950s by AI pioneer Arthur Samuel as 'the field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without explicitly being programmed.'
The definition holds true, according to Mikey Shulman, a lecturer at MIT Sloan and head of machine learning at Kensho, which specialises in artificial intelligence for the finance and US intelligence communities. He compared the traditional way of programming computers, or 'software 1.0', to baking, where a recipe calls for precise amounts of ingredients and tells the baker to mix for an exact amount of time.
Identify the title of the given passage.
